parsed.scene_description: A modern, well-lit bookstore or library interior featuring extensive wooden bookshelves filled with books. A central spiral bookshelf tower stands prominently. Several people are seated or standing, reading or browsing. Warm lighting illuminates the space, creating a cozy atmosphere. The floor is polished, reflecting the ambient light.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf tower
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical structure with multiple circular shelves spiraling upward, illuminated from within. It is centrally located, surrounded by seating. Books are arranged on its shelves. It appears freestanding but likely anchored to the floor.

objects.label: wooden bookshelves
objects.observation: Large, wall-mounted wooden shelves filled with books, extending across the background. They have recessed lighting underneath. Some sections feature arched alcoves with tables and stools. The shelves are integrated into the walls.

objects.label: person wearing white hoodie
objects.observation: A young man in a white hoodie with a cartoon logo and glasses, standing on the right side of the frame. He holds an object in his hand and looks toward the camera. His body partially obscures a plant behind him.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Several modern, curved orange chairs arranged in a group in the foreground. They are unoccupied and face inward. Their material appears to be molded plastic or leatherette. They rest directly on the polished floor.

objects.label: people seated at tables
objects.observation: Multiple individuals are seated at small tables, appearing to read or work. One person in a white coat sits at a high table under an arch. Others are near the spiral tower. Their postures suggest focus. Tables are supported by legs attached to the floor.

objects.label: large circular light fixture
objects.observation: A bright, circular light fixture mounted on the ceiling above the bookshelves. It emits strong illumination, casting a glow on the surrounding shelves. Its exact mounting is obscured by the angle.

objects.label: green potted plant
objects.observation: A leafy green plant in a pot, positioned on a low surface near the spiral tower. It is partially obscured by the person in the white hoodie. The pot rests on a flat surface, possibly a counter or shelf.
